welcome.title: Welcome to StoryForge
welcome.content1: StoryForge is an AI-assisted long-form novel writing tool that helps you manage the entire creative process from concept to final draft.
welcome.content2: Data is stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB) by default — no account needed. When you enable AI or cloud backup, relevant content is sent to the third-party services you configure.
welcome.content3: The next few steps will help you get started quickly.

configAi.title: Step 1: Configure AI
configAi.content1: Before using AI features, you need to set up an API key.
configAi.content2: Supported providers: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Tongyi Qianwen, Moonshot, Zhipu GLM, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
configAi.content3: Go to Settings, choose a provider, enter your API key and model name, then test the connection.
configAi.content4: Tip: DeepSeek offers great value (~¥1/million tokens) and works well for long-form writing.
configAi.tip: If you hit CORS errors, enable proxy mode in Settings (dev environment) or use a relay API endpoint.

createProject.title: Step 2: Create a Project
createProject.content1: Return to the home page, click "New Project", enter a title, pick a genre, and set a target word count.
createProject.content2: Once created, you'll enter the workspace with all modules in the left sidebar.
createProject.step2: Story Design → Establish core conflict and theme
createProject.step4: Detailed Outline → Flesh out each chapter's scenes

features.title: Core Features at a Glance
features.content1: AI Writing: Generate drafts, continue, expand, polish, and de-AI-ify text with custom instructions.
features.content2: State Tables: Automatically track character/location/item state changes and inject context while writing.
features.content3: Emotion Beats: Plan emotional arcs before drafting so AI generates more layered content.
features.content4: Foreshadowing: Track planted and resolved foreshadowing to avoid loose ends.
features.content5: Context Snapshots: Generate project state summaries to maintain coherence across chapters.
features.content6: Data Management: Backup, restore, and export — your data stays safe.
features.tip: Every feature has detailed error logs. If something goes wrong, open the browser console (F12) to investigate.
